## Testing-mode: GREEN

## Objective
Insert a self-contained dso.workflow shim block into plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh so that all RED tests from task 7744-d54a-8320-4261 pass.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh — insert shim block after arg parsing, before general resolution

## Critical Placement Note
The shim MUST be placed AFTER arg parsing (line ~34, after config_file and key are set) but BEFORE the general config_file resolution block (line ~42). Reason: the resolution block contains its own `exit 0` for missing config (when git root has no .claude/dso-config.conf). If the shim is placed after the resolution block, that early exit 0 fires before the shim can intercept for key==dso.workflow.

The shim handles its own config_file resolution internally using the same logic.

## Shim Block to Insert (after line ~34, before line ~42)

```bash
# ── dso.workflow canonical key: backward-compatible shim ──────────────────────
if [[ "$key" == "dso.workflow" ]]; then
    # Resolve config file (mirrors general resolution below)
    _wf_config="$config_file"
    if [[ -z "$_wf_config" ]]; then
        if [[ -n "${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE:-}" ]]; then
            _wf_config="${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE}"
        else
            _git_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "")
            if [[ -n "$_git_root" && -f "$_git_root/.claude/dso-config.conf" ]]; then
                _wf_config="$_git_root/.claude/dso-config.conf"
            fi
        fi
    fi
    # Missing config: direct user to onboarding (exit 1, not exit 0)
    if [[ ! -f "${_wf_config:-}" ]]; then
        echo "DSO: No .claude/dso-config.conf found. Run /dso:onboarding to configure dso.workflow." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    # Canonical key present: return directly (no deprecation warning)
    _canonical=$(grep -m1 "^dso\.workflow=" "$_wf_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    if [[ -n "$_canonical" ]]; then
        printf '%s' "$_canonical"
        exit 0
    fi
    # Legacy key fallback: map merge.strategy + enforcement.strategy
    _merge=$(grep -m1 "^merge\.strategy=" "$_wf_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    _enforce=$(grep -m1 "^enforcement\.strategy=" "$_wf_config" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
    if [[ -z "${DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET:-}" ]]; then
        echo "DSO deprecation: merge.strategy/enforcement.strategy are deprecated. Set dso.workflow=ci-pr|local in .claude/dso-config.conf" >&2
    fi
    if [[ "$_merge" == "pr" && "$_enforce" == "ci" ]]; then
        printf '%s' "ci-pr"
    else
        printf '%s' "local"
    fi
    exit 0
fi
# ── (existing general resolution continues below) ────────────────────────────
```

## Behavioral Invariants
- All 35 existing callers with non-dso.workflow keys: behavior completely unchanged
- Missing config + key != dso.workflow: still exits 0 via general resolution (unchanged)
- Missing config + key == dso.workflow: exits 1 with stderr message
- Canonical dso.workflow key present in config: returns value, no deprecation emitted
- Legacy merge.strategy=pr + enforcement.strategy=ci: returns ci-pr, deprecation to stderr
- Legacy merge.strategy=direct (or any non-ci-pr combination): returns local, deprecation to stderr
- DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1: no stderr output

## Done Definition
`bash tests/run-all.sh` passes — all RED tests from 7744-d54a-8320-4261 now GREEN, no regressions in existing test-read-config.sh tests.
